```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(gt)
library(codebook) # strictly for summary stats, remotes::install_github("rubenarslan/codebook")

# Load the datasets
# NOTE: Adjust paths if your data is inside a 'data/' subfolder

pollen_load_guts_24 <- read.csv(file.path("data","pollen_load_and_guts_2024_Succisa_pratensis.csv")) 

SVD_Suc_pra <- read.csv(file.path("data","SVD_Succisa_pratensis.csv")) 
```

```{r}
#| label: define-metadata
#| echo: true
library(stringr) # Needed for str_sub

# 1. Load data
df_pollen <- pollen_load_guts_24

# 2. RECREATE the derived variable (The fix)
df_pollen$plant_id <- str_sub(df_pollen$id, end=-3)

# 3. Now you can label it without error
var_label(df_pollen$id) <- "Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)"
var_label(df_pollen$plant_id) <- "Identifier for the individual plant (Derived from ID)"
var_label(df_pollen$suc_pra_load) <- "Count of Conspecific Pollen (CP)"
var_label(df_pollen$other_pollen_load) <- "Count of Heterospecific Pollen (HP)"
```

```{r}
#| label: variable-table-simple
#| echo: false

library(knitr)

# Create the summary table
meta_table <- look_for(df_pollen, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label)

# Print as a standard markdown table
kable(meta_table, 
      col.names = c("Variable Name", "Description"),
      caption = "Table 1: Description of variables in the pollen dataset.")
```
